expressions.title: The Zulfikar Ali Bhutto Trust and Peoples Foundation Trust (Re-naming and Administration) Order, 1978
expressions.title_basis: p1 (Gazette of Pakistan Extraordinary, Islamabad, March 26, 1978, p.73) prints the masthead, No. F. 24(2)/78-Pub. and 'THE ZULFIKAR ALI BHUTTO TRUST AND PEOPLES FOUNDATION TRUST (RE-NAMING AND ADMINISTRATION) ORDER, 1978, President's Order No. 4 of 1978', Articles 1-3; p2 (p.74) Article 4 and the signatures 'FAZAL ELAHI CHAUDHRY, President' and 'K. M. A. SAMDANI, Secretary' (block 1629216). The Judges (Leave, Pension and Privileges) (Amendment) Order, 1978 that follows on p2 stops in the middle of Article 2(b) at the end of this copy, so it is set aside as apparatus (owner policy q1 'split': no law created from a fragment).
